---
name: Agentik Dark
description: >-
  The Agentik brand design kit — the first real designkit. Three brand colors
  (blue, navy, white), a Poppins display / Poppins body type stack, and the
  Agentik logo marks. Dark surface scheme (navy canvas, white ink, lightened
  accent); a dark variant is provided for dark-mode surfaces and hero
  treatments.

typography:
  display:
    family: "'Poppins', sans-serif"
    size: "3rem"
    weight: 700
    lineHeight: 1.08
    letterSpacing: "-0.02em"
  h1:
    family: "'Poppins', sans-serif"
    size: "2.25rem"
    weight: 700
    lineHeight: 1.12
    letterSpacing: "-0.015em"
  h2:
    family: "'Poppins', sans-serif"
    size: "1.5rem"
    weight: 600
    lineHeight: 1.22
  h3:
    family: "'Poppins', sans-serif"
    size: "1.15rem"
    weight: 600
    lineHeight: 1.3
  body:
    family: "'Poppins', sans-serif"
    size: "1rem"
    weight: 400
    lineHeight: 1.6
  caption:
    family: "'Poppins', sans-serif"
    size: "0.8125rem"
    weight: 400
    lineHeight: 1.45
  label:
    family: "'Poppins', sans-serif"
    size: "0.75rem"
    weight: 600
    lineHeight: 1.4
    letterSpacing: "0.06em"
    textTransform: uppercase
  mono:
    family: "ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace"
    size: "0.85em"
  # Logo-only face — never use outside the wordmark (see brand README).
  wordmark:
    family: "'Poppins', sans-serif"
    weight: 700
spacing:
  xs: "0.25rem"
  sm: "0.5rem"
  md: "0.75rem"
  lg: "1rem"
  xl: "1.5rem"
  xxl: "2rem"
  section: "4rem"
  inset: "{spacing.md}"
  stack: "{spacing.md}"
  stack-lg: "{spacing.lg}"
  inline: "{spacing.sm}"
rounded:
  sm: "4px"
  md: "8px"
  lg: "14px"
  full: "9999px"
shadows:
  sm: "0 1px 2px rgba(10, 36, 71, 0.08)"
  md: "0 4px 14px rgba(10, 36, 71, 0.12)"
  lg: "0 16px 40px rgba(10, 36, 71, 0.18)"
motion:
  duration-fast: "120ms"
  duration: "200ms"
  duration-slow: "320ms"
  ease: "cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)"
  ease-out: "cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1)"
breakpoints:
  sm: "640px"
  md: "768px"
  lg: "1024px"
  xl: "1280px"
components:
  # ── Button: solid primary (Agentik blue) ──
  button-solid-primary:
    background: "{colors.accent}"
    color: "{colors.accent-fg}"
    border: "1px solid {colors.accent}"
    radius: "{rounded.md}"
    padding: "0.5rem 1.1rem"
    font: "{typography.label}"
    shadow: "{shadows.sm}"
  # ── Button: navy — high-emphasis action on light surfaces ──
  button-solid-navy:
    background: "{colors.brand-navy}"
    color: "{colors.brand-white}"
    border: "1px solid {colors.brand-navy}"
    radius: "{rounded.md}"
    padding: "0.5rem 1.1rem"
    font: "{typography.label}"
  # ── Button: outline neutral ──
  button-outline-neutral:
    background: "transparent"
    color: "{colors.ink}"
    border: "1px solid {colors.border-strong}"
    radius: "{rounded.md}"
    padding: "0.5rem 1.1rem"
  # ── Card ──
  card:
    background: "{colors.background}"
    border: "1px solid {colors.border}"
    radius: "{rounded.lg}"
    padding: "{spacing.xl}"
    shadow: "{shadows.md}"
  # ── Card: navy — hero / emphasis surface ──
  card-navy:
    background: "{colors.brand-navy}"
    color: "{colors.brand-white}"
    border: "1px solid {colors.brand-navy}"
    radius: "{rounded.lg}"
    padding: "{spacing.xl}"
  # ── Input ──
  input:
    background: "{colors.surface}"
    color: "{colors.ink}"
    border: "1px solid {colors.border}"
    radius: "{rounded.md}"
    padding: "0.45rem 0.7rem"
  # ── Badge / chip ──
  badge-soft-neutral:
    background: "{colors.surface-raised}"
    color: "{colors.ink-muted}"
    border: "1px solid {colors.border}"
    radius: "{rounded.full}"
    padding: "0.15rem 0.55rem"
  chip-active:
    background: "color-mix(in srgb, {colors.accent} 12%, transparent)"
    color: "{colors.accent-deep}"
    border: "1px solid color-mix(in srgb, {colors.accent} 55%, transparent)"
    radius: "{rounded.full}"
    padding: "0.15rem 0.55rem"
variants:
  agentik-dark:
    description: Dark scheme — navy canvas, white ink, blue accent.
    colors:
      background: "#0A2447"
      surface: "#12305A"
      surface-raised: "#1B3D6E"
      ink: "#FFFFFF"
      ink-muted: "#B7C7DE"
      accent: "#7FA9DC"
      accent-fg: "#0A2447"
      border: "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14)"
      border-strong: "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24)"
---

## Overview

Agentik is the brand design kit for Agentik — AI agents for business. The
palette is a strict three-color brand system: **Agentik Blue** `#5586C8` for
accent and emphasis, **Agentik Navy** `#0A2447` for text and dark surfaces, and
**White** for light surfaces and reversed logos. Everything else (surface tints,
muted inks, borders) is derived from these three by mixing.

## Colors

- Agentik Blue `#5586C8` — the accent. Primary buttons, links, active states,
  blue fills behind white marks. Keep it to emphasis; it should not flood the
  canvas.
- Agentik Navy `#0A2447` — the ink. All body text and headings on light
  surfaces, plus dark hero/footer surfaces.
- White `#FFFFFF` — light backgrounds and anything sitting on blue or navy.
- The light scheme (white canvas) is canonical; `agentik-dark` inverts the
  surface/ink ladder on the navy base for dark mode and hero sections.

## Typography

- **Poppins** (Google Fonts) for display and all headings — geometric with
  character, echoes the tech/agents positioning, contrasts the roundness of the
  wordmark.
- **Poppins** (Google Fonts) for body, UI, captions and labels — neutral and
  highly legible.
- **Poppins Bold** is the wordmark face and the wordmark face only: it matches
  the existing logo lettering ( font identity of the original wordmark — the PDF
  does not embed the font; the graphiste has not confirmed). Do not use Poppins
  anywhere else in the UI.
- Both Poppins and Poppins are free (Google Fonts); download and install locally
  — this machine's sandbox blocks font downloads.

## Marks

All mark paths are relative to the repository root and live under
`projects/agentik-branding/`:

- `logo/agentik-horizontal-slash-white-on-navy.png` — horizontal « Λgentik »
  lockup, white on navy (2966×2966 export).
- `icon/agentik-icon-slash-white-on-blue.jpeg` — slash mark, white on blue
  (949×949).
- `icon/agentik-icon-boxed-white-on-blue.jpeg` — boxed mark, white on blue
  (949×949).
- `transparent/agentik-wordmark-slash-{white,blue,navy}-transparent.png` — alpha
  wordmark ready to composite on any background (white for navy/blue or dark
  photo backgrounds; blue or navy for light backgrounds).

Regenerate all derived assets with `python3 tools/export-variants.py` from
`projects/agentik-branding/`. Vector provenance: `source/Agentik AI logo.pdf`
(2026-09-07).

## Layout

Three-step radius ladder (`sm` 4px, `md` 8px, `lg` 14px) plus `full` for pills.
Spacing follows the 4-pt Tailwind grid with semantic aliases. The breakpoint
ladder is the standard Tailwind set.

## Notes

- `accent` is a single token; soft variants are made with
  `color-mix(in srgb, {colors.accent} X%, transparent)` at the call site.
- Components named `button-{variant}-{tone}` follow the CVA naming convention
  (`<Button variant="solid" tone="primary">`).
- The brand palette is intentionally tiny — three colors. If a fourth seems
  needed, derive it with `color-mix` from blue or navy rather than adding a
  token.
